events.title: Northwich Victoria 's ground is confirmed to be up to Conference National standards. However, due to legal issues stemming from their spell in administration earlier in the season, their points total is zeroed and they are relegated from the Conference as a result. Previously relegated Forest Green replace them.

Spurs suspend their sporting director Frank Arnesen , and accuse 첼시 of making an illegal approach to him. 첼시 deny the accusations, claiming that they had made an official approach to the club regarding Arnesen.
George Burley resigns as manager of 더비 카운티 , citing differences with the club's board.
Goalkeeper and captain Edwin van der Sar plays his 100th international match for the Netherlands , when the side defeats Finland (0–4) in Helsinki .

UEFA changes the rules for the UEFA Champions League to ensure that the reigning champions will always be able to defend their title. The immediate effect is to allow 리버풀 to defend their crown, despite a fifth-place finish in the Premiership, outside the four slots currently allotted for England in the competition. 리버풀 will have to begin play in the first of three qualifying rounds. Mikael Forssell joins 버밍엄 시티 from 첼시 for £3 million after two seasons on loan.
로빈 판 페르시 , the Dutch 아스널 footballer, has been arrested in Rotterdam on suspicion of rape . (BBC)
뉴캐슬 유나이티드 sign 첼시 midfielder 스콧 파커 for £6.5 million.

사우샘프턴 manager 해리 레드냅 confirms reports that the Saints will bring on Sir Clive Woodward , former England rugby union head coach and current head coach of the British & Irish Lions , as director of football. Woodward will join Saints after the Lions tour.
former 볼턴 원더러스 assistant manager Phil Brown becomes 더비 카운티 's fifth manager in four years.

The Welsh champions Total Network Solutions , who had previously offered to play a two-legged playoff with Champions League holders 리버풀 for TNS's place in the first qualifying round of the competition, wind up being drawn against 리버풀 in the first qualifying round of the competition.

Spurs and 첼시 jointly announce that they have reached an agreement in principle regarding Spurs sporting director Frank Arnesen , who had been suspended after 첼시 had allegedly made an illegal approach to him. The next day, a 첼시 official revealed that the club paid £5 million.
첼시 sell Mateja Kezman to 아틀레티코 마드리드 for £5.3 million.
